description: Answers "Which of my backtests did better?" for 2 to 50 saved backtests (a whole parameter sweep fits one call), or pass experimentId instead of backtestIds to rank a parameter experiment's runs, including while it is still going ("how is it going?", "results so far"): finished runs are ranked and the answer says how many are still running. equity lines started at 100 on the same chart (the 10 best by total return) plus a metric table of every run (total return, CAGR, max drawdown, Sharpe, trades). Runs of one strategy with different parameter values are named by those values. Results are simulated. Read-only. Shows an interactive panel in apps that support MCP Apps; always returns a text summary and a botspot.trade link.
name: show_backtest_comparison
title: Compare backtests
